result.instructions: Tools for Campaigner, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our contact lists have the most active members?"; "Show me the campaigns sent last month and their open and click activity."; "Is this email address on a suppression list or a bounce list?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Campaigner data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run campaigner_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run campaigner_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run campaigner_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. campaigner_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: campaigner_get_account
tools.title: Get account and key permissions
tools.description: Return the Campaigner account name and the permissions this API key has (for example Campaigns_GetStats, Emails_Get). Use it first to see what the key can read. Campaigner API: GET /Ping.

tools.name: campaigner_get_database_columns
tools.title: List subscriber database columns
tools.description: List the custom subscriber fields (columns) defined in the account database. Use it before filtering subscribers by a field. Campaigner API: GET /Database.

tools.name: campaigner_get_database_column
tools.title: Get a subscriber database column
tools.description: Return the details of one custom subscriber field by name. Campaigner API: GET /Database/{columnName}.

tools.name: campaigner_list_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List all contact lists with their names, descriptions and active member counts. Campaigner API: GET /Lists.

tools.name: campaigner_get_list
tools.title: Get a contact list
tools.description: Return the details of one contact list. Campaigner API: GET /Lists/{listID}.

list_id.description: Numeric id from the matching list tool.

tools.name: campaigner_list_list_members
tools.title: List members of a contact list
tools.description: Page through the subscribers of one contact list. Campaigner API: GET /Lists/{listID}/Members (PageSize, PageNumber, Since).

list_id.description: Numeric id from the matching list tool.

page_size.description: Items per page (vendor default when omitted).

since.description: Only records since this date, in M/D/YYYY (vendor format, e.g. 11/1/2026).

annotations.title: List members of a contact list

tools.name: campaigner_add_emails_to_list
tools.title: Add subscribers to a list
tools.description: WRITE: add up to 100 email addresses to one contact list. Changes the customer's own list. Use it only for contacts who gave consent to email. Campaigner API: POST /Lists/{listID}/AddEmails. HTTP 400 can mean some addresses failed: read the Failures list.

list_id.description: Numeric id from the matching list tool.

tools.name: campaigner_remove_emails_from_list
tools.title: Remove subscribers from a list
tools.description: WRITE: remove up to 100 email addresses from one contact list. The contacts stop receiving that list's mail. Campaigner API: POST /Lists/{listID}/RemoveEmails.

list_id.description: Numeric id from the matching list tool.

tools.name: campaigner_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns by status
tools.description: List email campaigns in one status: active, sent, drafts, all, sending or scheduled. Campaigner API: GET /Campaigns, /Campaigns/Sent, /Campaigns/Drafts, /Campaigns/All, /Campaigns/Sending, /Campaigns/Scheduled.

page_size.description: Items per page (vendor default when omitted).

since.description: Only records since this date, in M/D/YYYY (vendor format, e.g. 11/1/2026).
